title: Voyager Has Less Memory Than One Photo on Your Phone
topic: Voyager 1's computers: 69.63 KB of memory across three computers, an 8-track digital tape recorder, 160 bit/s downlink, the 2023 memory-chip failure fixed from 24 billion km away in five months

beats.narration: The last photo you took is bigger than Voyager 1's entire memory.

beats.narration: The farthest machine humans ever built runs on three computers with sixty-nine kilobytes of memory. Combined.
Kilobytes? My selfies are bigger than that!
It can't even keep its own data. It records onto tape, on an eight-track tape recorder, and sends it home at a hundred and sixty bits per second.
phrases: It can't even keep its own

beats.narration: An old dial-up modem was more than a hundred times faster.
In 2023, one memory chip failed. With almost no room to spare, engineers squeezed a fix into the gaps, from twenty-four billion kilometers away.
phrases: a fix into the gaps, from

beats.narration: It took five months. And it worked. Nearly fifty years later, Voyager is still talking to us.
